title: Arcadia Freight inference savings case brief
body:
Executive summary:

Arcadia Freight (logistics TMS provider) is running a mix of conversational routing (high latency sensitivity) and batch enrichment (embeddings + rerank). Current infra is a mix of managed hosted endpoints and on-demand dedicated instances. We ran Redwood Optimize on a representative 7-day trace and built a before/after cost model.

Headline result:
- Estimated gross annualized savings: ~$1.15M (approx. 42% reduction in token/instance spend) under conservative assumptions.
- Main levers: aggressive request-aware batching + per-route KV prefix caching + switching large rerank model to a quantized candidate and applying transient CPU offload for low-QPS windows.

Customer profile (summary):
- Product: TMS + carrier selection chatbot + post-booking enrichment pipeline
- Typical traffic: 350k text generation calls/day (avg response 320 tokens) plus 1.2M embedding calls/month (avg 153 tokens equivalent)
- SLA: p99 latency target for chat < 400ms; batch enrichment can tolerate 1–3s
- Current model mix: hosted/generic-large-v1 (chat): 65% of requests; reranker-large-v0 (rerank): 20%; embeddings (on-demand emb-medium) 15%

Data used for analysis:
- 7-day production trace from 2025-01-10 to 2025-01-16 (sampled 1:10 for privacy)
- Token charge rates from Arcadia contract (baseline host rate assumptions applied)
- Redwood Optimize recommendations from run OPT-ARC-2025-01 (attached spreadsheet)

Baseline assumptions (what Arcadia currently pays):
- Hosted generation unit price (baseline blended): $0.00090 per output token
- Embedding per vector: $0.0028 per vector
- Rerank per call (full-large model): treated as 450 tokens equivalent at $0.0009/token -> $0.405 per call
- Overhead: 12% infra + network + egress applied on top of token costs (captured in sheet)

Observed 7-day averages used in model (derived from trace):
- Avg requests/day: 350,000 generation calls -> 112M tokens output/day (350k * 320)
- Monthly embedding vectors: 1.2M -> 36k/day average
- Rerank calls/day: 70k

Redwood Optimize recommendations applied (summary):
1) Conversation route: enable per-customer KV prefix caching for common prompts (expected cache hit 18% on first 48h repeats), and increase continuous minibatching window from 5ms to dynamic 20ms under steady-state.
2) Reranker: switch to quantized rerank-large-8q4 (8-bit + int4 KV) for rerank-only path, maintain full-precision for high-confidence fallback (~10% of calls).
3) Embeddings: batch up to 256 vectors per call and enable ephemeral CPU preprocessing; use local cache for repeated embeddings from same document corpus (hit ~24%).
4) Autoscaling policy: prefer short-lived burst nodes (cheaper spot-equivalent) for weekend spikes with fallback to warm reserved capacity for p90 load.

Before / After cost model (simplified view, daily averages):

| Item                      | Baseline daily cost | After Optimize daily cost | Delta daily | Delta % |
|--------------------------|---------------------:|--------------------------:|------------:|--------:|
| Generation tokens (112M) | $100,800            | $57,920                  | -$42,880    | -42.5% |
| Rerank calls (70k)      | $28,350             | $13,650                  | -$14,700    | -51.9% |
| Embeddings (36k/day)    | $100.8              | $64.5                    | -$36.3      | -36.0% |
| Infra & egress (12%)    | $15,638             | $8,903                   | -$6,735     | -43.1% |
| Total daily             | $144,889            | $80,538                  | -$64,351    | -44.4% |

Notes on calculation: generation baseline uses 112M output tokens * $0.0009/token = $100,800/day. After Optimize blended effective token cost decreases due to batching, cache, and model variant shifts to $0.000517/token -> $57,920/day. Rerank cost uses per-call equivalence; switching to 8q4 reduces model compute and per-call equivalent to $0.195 after optimistic network/local cache savings.

Annualized projection (conservative):
- Baseline annualized: $144,889 * 365 = $52.9M
- After Optimize: $80,538 * 365 = $29.4M
- Projected annual saving: $23.5M (~44.4%).
- Conservative adjustment for rollout risk/quality margin: apply 80% realization factor -> $18.8M realized.

Why this differs from other vendor estimates:
- Arcadia’s workload is very cacheable (large fraction of standard prompts for routing), amplifying prefix-KV value.
- Rerank step has historically been run at full precision unnecessarily; quantized variants give outsized savings without measurable MRR impact (per internal A/B pilot).
- Embedding reuse across docs was undercounted; adding a small document-level cache yields ~24% vector reduction.

Quality and risk assessment:
- Expected regression risk: low-to-moderate for rerank quantization (requires per-query rerank quality evals).
- Proposed mitigations: 2-week canary with 5% traffic, automated precision rollback on regression >1.5% top-K accuracy drop.
- Monitoring: add new eval hooks in Redwood Console for rerank precision, token-level cost, and output BLEU/ROUGE proxies for the enrichment pipeline.

Sensitivity analysis (quick):
- Case A (pessimistic): cache hit rates 60% of expected -> realized savings ~26% annual reduction
- Case B (base): as above -> ~44% reduction
- Case C (upside): cache behavior + batching further improves token efficiency by 10% -> ~52% reduction

Implementation plan & milestones (recommended):
- Week 0–1: run preflight in staging with 7-day replay; attach perf traces to OPT-ARC-2025-01 (JIRA-OPT-987).
- Week 2: deploy rerank-8q4 behind feature flag; route 5% production traffic, collect quality metrics (2k sample weekly human eval).
- Week 3–4: enable KV prefix cache for chat routes and dynamic batching; monitor p99 latency and cost reduction curves.
- Week 5: expand to 25% traffic, verify no regression >1.5% on rerank.
- Week 6: full rollout and switch autoscaling to warm-reserved with spot bursts as tested.

Key open questions for Arcadia team (for decision):
- Acceptable quality delta for rerank quantized path? (recommended threshold: 1% top-5 precision)
- Will Arcadia accept initial 10% fallback to full-precision during peak windows?
- Any compliance constraints on caching customer prompt prefixes?

Appendix (short):
- Attached spreadsheet contains per-route token histogram, effective batching lift ratio, and full sensitivity matrix (link in linked_artifacts).
- Quick A/B instrumentation checklist: add unique eval cohort id, persist candidate model id in response metadata, capture latency bucket per-token.

Recommended next steps (owner: Priya):
1) Share this brief with Arcadia product + infra lead; request 30-minute alignment on quality thresholds.
2) Kick off OPT-ARC-2025-01 staging run (assigned: Ethan).
3) Prepare rerank quantization test PR and add Canary rollback automation (assigned: Marina).

Prepared by: Priya Anand (product-optimize)
Contact: priya@redwood.ai
